adjudication.family_description: A UK Ltd transfers £2,500 to its director with no message; an open contractor bill of the same amount is the only candidate explanation in scope.
adjudication.error_mode: owner transaction: salary, loan repayment, dividend or reimbursement is an owner-only fact unless a source records it
adjudication.label_reason: A dividend voucher and board minute in the book record a £2,500.00 interim dividend to M Hartley paid on 05/09/2026: the transfer is explained by a source and is not the contractor bill.
adjudication.terminal_reason: The evidence exists (the voucher); the transfer does not settle the bill; the dividend posting is remaining work outside this contract.
